title: Object type
description: Schema definition of a real-world entity or event. Metadata matches Ontology Manager object type metadata; backing datasource, index status, and writeback are omitted as Foundry platform concerns.

displayName.description: Singular name shown in user applications.

pluralDisplayName.description: Plural name shown when viewing multiple objects.

aliases.description: Extra search terms in Ontology Manager / Object Explorer.

primaryKey.description: Single property that uniquely identifies each object. Must exist in properties and be a valid primary-key base type.

titleKey.description: Property used as the display name for objects of this type.

implements.description: Interface API names this object type implements.

properties.description: Map of property API name to property definition. Keys must match each property's apiName.
